function autoPlay() {
  var _this = this;
  var _wdPlayBtn;
  var autoPlayTimer = null;
  var config = {
    id: '',
    duration: 5,
    tabCounts: 0,
    tabNav: {}
  };
  var nowTabCount = 0;
  var tabCount = 0;
  var isPaused = false;
  var isFocussed = false;
  var tabNavFn = {};

  // 暫停時參數
  var nowTabDuration = 0;

  //記錄暫停初時值
  var pauseTimeStart = 0;

  //記錄暫停總長
  var pauseTimeDuration = 0;
  var forcePlaySpeed = null;
  var getTime = function getTime() {
    return new Date().getTime();
  };
  var autoPlayClear = function autoPlayClear() {
    if (autoPlayTimer) {
      clearInterval(autoPlayTimer);
      autoPlayTimer = null;
      // console.log(autoPlayTimer ? 'not Clear' : 'autoPlayTimer is already cleared');
    }
  };
  this.autoPlay = function () {
    // console.log('Auto Play start.', config);
    if (!config.tabCounts > 1) {
      return;
    }
    _wdPlayBtn.showPause();
    pauseTimeStart = 0;
    autoPlayClear();
    var _checkCount = function _checkCount(nextCount) {
      var rs = nextCount;
      if (nextCount > config.tabCounts - 1) {
        rs = 0;
      }
      return rs;
    };
    var _play2 = function _play() {
      autoPlayClear();
      var playSpeed = config.duration;
      var tabNavCfg;
      if (tabNavFn["tab".concat(nowTabCount)]) {
        tabNavCfg = tabNavFn["tab".concat(nowTabCount)];
        playSpeed = tabNavCfg.duration || playSpeed;
      }
      playSpeed = forcePlaySpeed || playSpeed;
      // console.log('Play', nowTabCount, playSpeed);
      nowTabDuration = playSpeed;
      autoPlayTimer = setInterval(function () {
        if (!isPaused && !isFocussed) {
          var nextCount = _checkCount(nowTabCount + 1);
          config.tabClick(nextCount);
          nowTabCount = nextCount;
          _play2();
        } else {
          // console.log('is paused.....');
        }
      }, playSpeed);
    };
    //
    nowTabCount = nowTabCount || tabCount;
    isPaused = false;
    //!重新播放時，計算暫停的時間差
    if (pauseTimeStart) {
      var nowTime = getTime();
      pauseTimeDuration = nowTime - pauseTimeStart;
      var lastDuration = nowTabDuration - pauseTimeDuration;
      // console.log({ nowTabCount, pauseTimeDuration, nowTabDuration, lastDuration });
      forcePlaySpeed = null;
      if (pauseTimeDuration > 0 && lastDuration > 0) {
        // tab 輪播剩餘時間(預設/指定輪播) - 暫停時間總長 > 0,  繼續剩餘時間。
        forcePlaySpeed = lastDuration;
      } else if (pauseTimeDuration && lastDuration < 0) {
        // tab 輪播剩餘時間(預設/指定輪播) - 暫停時間總長 < 0, 直接切下一個。
        nowTabCount = _checkCount(nowTabCount + 1);
      }
      pauseTimeStart = 0;
    }
    _play2();
  };
  this.pause = function () {
    // console.log('Auto Play pause.');
    isPaused = true;
    autoPlayClear();
    pauseTimeStart = getTime();
    pauseTimeDuration = 0;
    forcePlaySpeed = null;
    // console.log({ nowTabCount, pauseTimeDuration, nowTabDuration });
    _wdPlayBtn.showPlay();
  };
  this.resetCount = function (count) {
    nowTabCount = count;
    _this.pause();
  };
  //
  this.init = function (_config) {
    var _ = this;
    config = $.extend({}, config, _config);
    config.tabNav.forEach(function (tab) {
      tabNavFn["tab".concat(tab.index)] = tab;
    });
    if (!$(config.container).length || !config.btnContainer.length) {
      return;
    }
    _wdPlayBtn = new (require("../../../base/js/modules/wdPlayBtn.js"))();
    _wdPlayBtn.start(config.btnContainer, {
      resumeFn: function resumeFn() {
        // console.log('wdPlayBtn: play');
        _.autoPlay();
      },
      pauseFn: function pauseFn() {
        // console.log('wdPlayBtn: Stop');
        _.pause();
      }
    });
  };
}

  function _handleTabPanelFn() {
    // callback 函式

     * @param {*} observer

    var callback = function callback(entries) {
      // console.group('observerDom:wdtab__panel__item');
      entries.forEach(function (e) {

      threshold: [0]

      observer.observe($(this)[0]);
    });
  }

    "DisclaimerStar": [
      "The visual appearance of OLED displays may change over the product’s lifetime. This is expected behavior that can include image persistence or burn-in, where the display shows a faint remnant of an image even after a new image appears on the screen. This tends to occur only in extreme use cases, such as when a static, high-contrast image is continuously displayed for prolonged periods of time. ASUS laptops with an OLED display minimize this risk by setting Windows’s Dark mode as default, as well as shortening the idle time before the screen is turned off — both on mains (AC) and battery (DC) power. This dual approach minimizes the potential for burn-in to maximize the lifespan of your OLED display lifespan, and also reduces unnecessary power draw for optimal battery life. We also recommended adjust the brightness of your OLED display to complement the ambient lighting in your environment, rather than keeping the screen at maximum brightness at all times. You should also ensure that you have an animated, dark-background screensaver enabled in the Windows Settings tool."

      "section5": {
        "content": {
          "title": [
            "Optimal click ratio: Engineered to perfection"
          ],
          "info": [
            "The feel of a keyboard depends on the crucial ratio between the peak force (also known as the actuation force) and the contact force. Peak force occurs when you press down on the key and reach the maximum force that the key’s underlying rubber dome can withstand without deflecting. Contact force occurs when the bottom of the key touches the circuit board to trigger an electronic signal, which in turn generates the action appropriate to the key. To achieve the most natural feel for a keyboard, ASUS keyboard experts have scientifically determined that the optimal ergonomic click ratio for a key is between 45-60%. These forces are precisely measured and tuned using the ASUS-designed rubber domes beneath the keys."

        "disclaimer": "The visual appearance of OLED displays may change over the product’s lifetime. This is expected behavior that can include image persistence or burn-in, where the display shows a faint remnant of an image even after a new image appears on the screen. This tends to occur only in extreme use cases, such as when a static, high-contrast image is continuously displayed for prolonged periods of time. ASUS laptops with an OLED display minimize this risk by setting Windows’s Dark mode as default, as well as shortening the idle time before the screen is turned off — both on mains (AC) and battery (DC) power. This dual approach minimizes the potential for burn-in to maximize the lifespan of your OLED display lifespan, and also reduces unnecessary power draw for optimal battery life. We also recommended adjust the brightness of your OLED display to complement the ambient lighting in your environment, rather than keeping the screen at maximum brightness at all times.
